title: Repair Parts Share by Room: Security Deposit Account Table
content:
Parts on a Security Deposit Account damage repair charge are charged at a share of their recorded cost. The parts cost of a damage repair charge is charged at a parts share that follows the room repaired. The room is the one recorded on the damage repair line.

| Room recorded on the repair line | Parts share |
|---|---|
| kitchen | 0.80 |
| Bathroom 1 | 0.80 |
| Bathroom 2 | 0.80 |
| living room | 0.90 |
| dining area | 0.90 |
| den | 0.90 |
| entry | 0.90 |
| any other room | 1 (the parts cost in full) |

**Use.** The parts cost recorded on the repair line is multiplied by the parts share. The corrected repair charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Hypothetical figures.** For a recorded parts cost of 120.00 USD, the parts charged are 96.00 USD in the kitchen, 108.00 USD in the den and 120.00 USD in a bedroom.
